rtr.text: Emmara Tandris is commanded by Trostani to investigate the Izzet and is given command of the conclave's elementals, and she forgives Jace, though House Dimir has followed her.

Jace erases his memory of the Izzet's secrets as Emmara watches helpless, and she goes willingly with the Rakdos, escapes to the Golgari sewers and saves Jace from Varolz before Mirko Vosk gravely wounds her.

Emmara is later arrested for treason, then exposes Lazav, who had replaced Calomir, and runs the maze with Jace, withstanding Exava's demons at the Rakdos guildgate until Trostani arrives with reinforcements.
Jace's telepathy stops the Maze at the Forum of Azor, triggering the Supreme Verdict that makes him Living Guildpact, and Emmara then asks him to erase her memory of the other worlds, and he agrees.
